svg.title: Your screen keeps sharing — automatic capture fallback
svg.desc: After you enable Faster screen sharing in Settings, General and restart Sysvia, a startup check tests that pictures arrive and encoding takes less than 25 milliseconds. If it passes, Sysvia uses its own engine. If it cannot pass, browser capture takes over automatically. Both outcomes keep a native Windows desktop visible. These are two possible outcomes, not repeated switching during a session.
svg.text: Sysvia tests the faster engine at startup and chooses the capture that works.
Enable Faster screen sharing in Settings → General, then restart Sysvia.
Off by default. The offer to enable it appears only on NVIDIA PCs.
